items.title: A per-user self-update leaves the daemon down until the next logon: RegisterAutostart cannot replace a task registered elevated
items.summary:
**Found while reading #3302 on agent 0.4.200.** No fix is proposed or in progress here.

## What I saw

The rig was a throwaway Windows 11 lab guest. Per-user 0.4.199 was installed there with `msiexec /i … /qn` from an elevated session, enrolled, and started through its Scheduled Task (`schtasks /Run /TN Roomler`), so the launcher and the daemon ran in the console session. At 12:34:09Z on 2026-11-05, three seconds after that start, the updater found 0.4.200, spawned the per-user MSI and exited.

items.title: DownloadCache: a 31-bit hash in cache names lets a colliding URL overwrite another's cached file
items.summary:
discovered-in #2416

## Problem

`DownloadCache.cacheFilename` names a cached file by `String.hashCode` of the URL (31 bits) plus its basename.
Colliding URLs are easy to craft: the hash is linear, so `.../Aa/asset` and `.../BB/asset` share a name, and so do `https://evil.example/p/acgysyfc/latest` and `https://downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/latest` (both `66129e10-latest`).
Two downloads of colliding URLs share the cached path, so one can overwrite the file the other has just returned
